DROPPED, exhaustively probed (this is the Phase 6 timeline() engine - full detail in tranche5_mix_env.md section 1): CDP wants 'submix mix mixfile outfile' with the mixfile BEFORE the output, but build_cdp_argv renders every parameter (including aux_file) AFTER the output, and the mixfile cannot be an entry input either (.mix/.txt is unknown_input_domain to the PVOC gate). RECOMMENDATION: a ParameterSpec position field (e.g. 'pre_output') consumed by build_cdp_argv, or timeline() assembles its own argv and enters at the security gate. formants put has the same pre-output slot - one fix unblocks both.

Mixfile line syntax (binary-verified): 'sndname start chans level', 'sndname start 1 level pan', 'sndname start 2 llev lpan rlev rpan'. chans must match the file (mismatch: WARNING + 'Application doesn't work with this type of infile.'). level = multiplier or '-6dB' form; PLAIN NEGATIVE LEVELS REFUSED. pan -1/0/+1, beyond +-1 = hard side attenuated by 1/|pan|; manual's letter pans L/R work, 'C' does NOT act as centre (behaves as no-pan). Tabs, CRLF, ';' comments, blank lines, unsorted times all fine; negative start times refused; paths with spaces impossible (whitespace-split; quoting doesn't help).

Path resolution (cwd = session root, mixfile in data/): relative paths resolve against the process CWD, NEVER the mixfile's own directory ('inputs/n1.wav' works; a bare name next to the mixfile refuses 'uses only_in_data.wav which is not a sndfile'). Absolute and ./ paths work.

OUTPUT DURATION RULE (verified sample-exact on 6 configs incl. a 40-event accelerando): outdur = max(start_i + dur_i) - min(start_i) - leading silence before the FIRST event is stripped; interior gaps preserved. timeline() must predict max(at+dur) - min(at), not max(at+dur).

HEADLINE - OVERLOAD WRAPS: summing is exactly linear, and when the sum exceeds full scale the output is bit-identical to 16-bit integer WRAPAROUND of the sum (3 full-level copies: float peak 2.85, 12182 overs, maxdiff vs wrap 0.0) - positive overs come back as large negative samples. The -a 'may avoid clipping' flag was byte-identical to the unflagged run (no-op here). modify loudness 1 in the same build CLIPS - headroom must be staged before the mix. Pre-flight companion verified: 'submix getlevel 1 mixfile' prints 'MAX SAMPLE ENCOUNTERED : 2.850123 at 0.086304 secs / NORMALISATION REQUIRED : 0.350862 OR -9.0973dB'.
SR: all sources must share one rate ('WARNING: ... Incompatible sample-rate in file inputs/n1_22k.wav' + infile-type refusal); an all-22050 mixfile renders at 22050.

DROPPED, fully probed: mode 1's output is a binary envelope file dressed as a RIFF/WAVE - FLOAT subtype, SAMPLE RATE 57, 115 frames for a 2 s input at wsize 20 (one float per window). CDP writes it under ANY name including .wav (and appends .wav itself to extensionless names), so an entry would mint an SR-57 pseudo-wav that PASSES output verification (soundfile reads it, rms computes) and silently poisons downstream audio consumers - worse than a hard failure. The engine derives output extension from the domain (node_validation step 9: time -> '.wav'), leaving no way to express an .env output.

Mode 2 (text brkfile) is equally inexpressible and refuses reserved-extension names outright: 'ERROR: Cannot open a textfile (x6.wav) with a reserved extension.' Content: tab-separated time/level pairs (116 lines at wsize 20 on 2 s); -d datareduce enforced 0-1 (refusals quote '(0.000000 to 1.000000)', parameter 2); -d0.5 reduced 116 lines -> 6; -d0 = no reduction.

DROPPED, fully probed: 'formants put 1 infile fmntfile outfile [-i][-l][-h][-g]' - the .for slot sits BETWEEN input and output, i.e. before the output, exactly like submix mix's mixfile (same build_cdp_argv layout gap), and it cannot be input 2 either (.for is unknown_input_domain to the PVOC gate).

Behavior on the binary: modes 1 (replace own formants) and 2 (impose on top) both exit 0; output duration = the input .ana's duration regardless of the .for's length (1 s .ana + 2 s .for -> 1.026 s; 2 s .ana -> 2.029 s). -i quicksearch and -l/-h/-g all exit 0. Deterministic in the data chunk.
One pre-output-position schema extension plus aux_file acceptance of a .for (binary, not text - the aux_file docstring currently says TEXT) unblocks it; formants vocode ships the use-case meanwhile.

DROPPED on a source-confirmed binary defect: repeated identical runs yield different analysis data with garbage amplitudes. Mode 1, 8 runs -> per-run max amp inf / 5.19e18 / 2.81e22 / 1.09e35 / inf / inf / 2.68e26 / 0.496 (7 of 8 poisoned); mode 2: 3 of 4; modes 5/6: NaN + inf amps, mode 5 synth = digital silence. A poisoned mode-1 render synthesizes to full-scale noise (RMS 0.9999, pvoc synth warns 'use gain of <= 0.000000'); the rare clean render is musically sane (RMS 0.042) - the algorithm works, the memory doesn't.

Mechanism (source): dev/hilite/ap_hilite.c:820 mallocs the ARPE_KEEP sustain-counter array without zeroing; do_on() in hilite.c treats nonzero garbage as an active sustained arpegtone and sustain_arpeg_note() computes amp = window_amp * KEEP[cc]/SUST - heap garbage becomes a gain of up to inf. Clean runs happen only when the allocator returns zeroed pages. One-line calloc fix upstream would make this curatable; stochastic recorded false (this is a defect, not a random feature).
